checklist: balance air: Air against the reference / wanted: -11.7 to -8.7 dB / fix: an EQ Eight toward the reference's shape (tune with how: fit)
checklist: balance bass: Bass against the reference / wanted: -10.5 to -7.5 dB / fix: an EQ Eight toward the reference's shape (tune with how: fit)
checklist: balance brilliance: Brilliance against the reference / wanted: -11.7 to -8.7 dB / fix: an EQ Eight toward the reference's shape (tune with how: fit)
checklist: balance low mids: Low mids against the reference / wanted: -10.5 to -7.5 dB / fix: an EQ Eight toward the reference's shape (tune with how: fit)
checklist: balance mids: Mids against the reference / wanted: -10.5 to -7.5 dB / fix: an EQ Eight toward the reference's shape (tune with how: fit)
checklist: balance presence: Presence against the reference / wanted: -10.5 to -7.5 dB / fix: an EQ Eight toward the reference's shape (tune with how: fit)
checklist: balance sub: Sub against the reference / wanted: -9.5 to -6.5 dB / fix: an EQ Eight toward the reference's shape (tune with how: fit)
checklist: balance upper mids: Upper mids against the reference / wanted: -10.5 to -7.5 dB / fix: an EQ Eight toward the reference's shape (tune with how: fit)
checklist: loudness: Loudness / wanted: -9 LUFS ±0.5 / fix: the last limiter's gain, homed in (tune with how: home, knobs ["limiter gain"])
checklist: low width: Stereo below 120 Hz, as the reference / wanted: ≤ -6 dB
checklist: rumble: Rumble / wanted: ≤ -15 dB / fix: a high pass at about 25–30 Hz
checklist: true peak: True peak / wanted: ≤ -1 dBTP / fix: a true-peak limiter last, its ceiling under the target (tune with how: home, knobs ["ceiling"])
listen: not connected: [error] Kumi isn't connected to Live, so it can't hear the Set.
listen: nothing named: [error] Name what to hear: a file, an audio clip's clipRef, a track (or tracks), or mix: true.
listen: the integration's refusal: [error] Live stopped before the part's end.
listen: tracks together, heard as: as it played, as it played
listen: tracks together, its note: A clash is two sounds strong in the same band at similar levels: carve one (EQ Eight), sidechain it (a compressor keyed from the other), or move one up or down an octave.
masking unfair: missed: Masking can't be read through Main's chain (Glue Compressor, Limiter): it's left off the checklist. Kumi couldn't hear the mix as it comes into Main's chain this time (Kumi Ears didn't answer)
masking unfair: no Max for Live: Masking can't be read through Main's chain (Glue Compressor, Limiter): it's left off the checklist. With Max for Live, Kumi hears the mix as it comes into Main's chain and reads masking there
problem: clipping: 120 samples at full scale, at 0:03, 1:05 / fix: lower the level into whatever clips (often the master, or a track driven into it)
problem: dc offset: a DC offset of -40 dBFS / fix: a high pass (any, even at 5 Hz) on the track that carries it
problem: rumble: sub rumble: under 30 Hz is only 5 dB below 30–120 Hz / fix: a high pass at about 25–30 Hz
problem: stereo lows: stereo below 120 Hz: the side is 10 dB under the mid there / fix: mono below about 120 Hz (Utility's Bass Mono)
problem: true peak: true peaks reach 0.4 dBTP (the highest at 0:12), over the -1 dBTP ceiling / fix: a true-peak limiter at the end with its ceiling at -1 dBTP
structure move: density: change the MIDI: more or fewer notes, another rhythm
structure move: envelope: change the instrument family (a plucked or struck model against a sustained one), or add a transient shaper (Drum Buss, Compressor)
structure move: excess-low: high-pass it (EQ Eight), take the low layer out, or change the base
structure move: excess-mids: cut the mids (EQ Eight), change the base, or thin the layers
structure move: excess-top: low-pass it (Auto Filter), use a darker base (sine, triangle), or take a layer out
structure move: missing-low: add a sub layer (an Operator sine or a Drift one octave down, in a rack chain), an EQ Eight low shelf, or change the base instrument
structure move: missing-mids: add a layer for the body (a second oscillator or a rack chain), or change the base
structure move: missing-top: add saturation (Saturator, Roar), an exciter or a brighter base (a saw or noise layer)
structure move: pitched: change the kind of source: a tonal oscillator against noise or a sample
structure move: register: transpose it (the MIDI, or the instrument's octave), or change the base
structure move: width: widen or narrow it: Utility width, Chorus-Ensemble, or parallel chains panned apart
